review_notes: I read the whole file. I grepped Mathlib for other endofunctor algebra or coalgebra structures. The only other users are Mathlib/CategoryTheory/Preadditive/EndoFunctor.lean, which builds on this file, and the monad and comonad (co)algebras in Mathlib/CategoryTheory/Monad/Algebra.lean. Monad algebras carry extra unit and associativity axioms, so they are a different concept and not a competing version of these F-algebras. This file's Algebra and Coalgebra could be written as Comma F (𝟭 C) and Comma (𝟭 C) F. I found no existing Mathlib spelling of that, and a dedicated structure with its own category instance, forget functor and natural-transformation functors is a reasonable chosen representation. The Algebra and Coalgebra halves duplicate each other, but they are duals, not a competing Mathlib concept. I found nothing in Mathlib, Batteries or Lean core that this file independently redefines.
